title: CPSC, National Service Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Zep Commercial Cleaners Sold at The Home Depot
summary: Some of these bottles can leak through the cap when turned on their side, allowing the contents of the cleaner to come into contact with consumers. These cleaners can cause irritation and burns to the skin and eyes. Units: About 1.4 million.

title: CPSC, Xanadu Candle Co. Announce Recall of Candles
summary: These candles can burn with a high flame, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 2.8 million.

title: CPSC, Double L Announce Recall of Lighters
summary: These lighters can leak butane when they are ignited, causing an excessive burst of flame. This presents a risk of fire and burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 180,000.

title: CPSC, McDonald's Announce Recall of "Scooter Bug" Happy Meal Toys
summary: The bug's antenna can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 234,000.

title: CPSC, Arusa International Recall Children's Bathrobes
summary: These bathrobes fail to meet the Standard for the Flammability of Children's Sleepwear, and pose a risk of burn injury to children, due to the possible ignition of the garment. Units: About 1,175.

title: CPSC, Hurricane Products Announce Recall of Propane Regulators
summary: These regulators can leak propane, which can result in a fire or explosion. The leak can cause the appliance flame to be larger than expected, possibly causing burns to nearby consumers and cause nearby combustibles to catch fire. Units: About 20,000.

title: CPSC, Remington Products Co., LLC Announce Recall of Hairdryers
summary: These hairdryers are not equipped with an appliance leakage current interrupter plug (ALCI plug) to cut off electrical current in case of contact with water. If dropped in water, the hairdryers pose an electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: CPSC, Deere & Company Recall Gator Utility Vehicles
summary: During manufacturing, an extra internal vent line was attached to the plastic vent fitting on some fuel tanks. If the fuel inside the gas tank expands, it can leak out through the extra vent line and onto the ground, presenting fire and burn hazards. Units: About 550.

title: CPSC, Jade Products Inc. Announce Recall of Dynasty Gas Ranges
summary: The igniters are too far from the burners, which can cause a delayed ignition of gas. The large amount of gas released can cause fire to escape from the oven, putting consumers at risk of burn injuries and house fires. Units: About 3,300.

title: CPSC, Maytag Corp. Announce Recall of Maytag, Magic Chef Gas Ranges
summary: The vent flue insulation can be out of position on these ranges. Using the broil or self-clean functions on these ranges can cause scorching or burning of the cabinetry around the range, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 14,800.

title: CPSC, STIHL Inc. Announce Recall of Backpack Blowers
summary: The fuel hose on the carburetor can be dislodged, and leak fuel, presenting fire and burn hazards. Units: About 890.

title: CPSC, Eight Firms Announce the Recall of Zapper Toys
summary: The balloon tongues and the cylinders holding the tongues on these toys can detach, posing a choking and aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 835,000.

title: CPSC, Meijer Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Wands
summary: The batteries can short-circuit, causing the wands' handles to become very hot and melt the plastic, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Ariens Co. Announce Recall of Lawn Mowers
summary: The piece attaching the blade to the mower can crack and break off. The broken piece or the blade can be propelled from underneath the mower, possibly injuring the operator or a bystander. Units: About 40,000.

title: CPSC, Pacific Cycle LLC Announce Recall of Water Bottles Included With Girls' Bikes
summary: The drinking valve on the cap can detach, presenting a potential choking hazard. Units: About 42,000.

title: CPSC, Radica USA Ltd. Recall Baseball Video Games to Replace Bats
summary: The bats can separate during a swing. Broken pieces can hit a bystander and cause injury. Units: About 140,000.

title: CPSC, The Designers Edge Announce Recall of Fluorescent Worklights
summary: The worklight's power cord has loose connections, which could result in live wires being exposed. It poses electrocution and shock hazards to consumers. Also, the firm mislabeled the worklight. The product improperly bears the UL mark and is marked "suitable for wet locations." Units: About 180.

title: CPSC, Burger King and Alcone Announce Recall of Kid's Meal Toys
summary: Metal pins with plastic caps that attach the paddle wheel to the riverboat toy can come out and pose a choking hazard. Units: About 400,000.

title: CPSC, Cosco Inc. and Safety 1st Announce Recall of Bungee Baby Jumpers and Wipe Warmers
summary: The Bungee Baby Jumper allows a baby to bounce while supported in a seat by an elastic "bungee cord," suspended from a doorway. title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Infant and Toddler Toys
summary: Two red knobs on the toy can break off, creating small parts that can pose a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 20,000.

title: CPSC, Levi Strauss & Co. Announce Recall of Infant and Toddler Garments
summary: Parts from the metal inseam snaps can detach from the garment, posing a choking risk for young children. Units: Approximately 349,000.

title: CPSC, White Consolidated Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Air Conditioners
summary: These air conditioners can short circuit, posing a risk of fires, and shock and burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 17,000.

title: CPSC, Gymboree Announce Recall of Children's Fleece Pants
summary: The cord locks on the pants can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 125,000.
